acceptance: All parent subsets authenticated; every selected forecast joins exactly; all168account ledgers reconcile; all7616coverage slots preserved; meaningful tamper/maturity tests; actual crash recovery and identical portable outputs.
chronology: No new fit or split. All original dates are inspected development. Original prequential base/layer identities retained; no new confirmation claim.
concentration_scope: Filled-episode counts and declared decision USD sizing, not simultaneous/time-weighted currency exposure; no incompatible currency units summed.
futility_stop: Stop affected computation on identity,maturity,coverage,reconciliation or resource failure; no silent fallback or invented outcomes.
hypothesis: Preserved layer policy underperformance can be separated descriptively into selected forecast error, position concentration, realized trading costs, management decisions and unavailable valuation; no causal counterfactual claim.
matching: Same causal support across raw_matched/signed_only/magnitude_interaction within each learner/mode. Raw unrestricted availability comparison remains separate. Costs are existing separately replayed paths.
maturity: Exact original (record_id,target_id), unique key, exact label end equals target, availability>=label_end and <=assessment_asof. Null label remains unavailable; no historical outcome in decision-time signals.
negative_or_inconclusive: A diagnosis can remain unresolved or disagree across paths. Preserve all outputs; do not tune or promote a method.

basis.reason: 473.6MB preserved JSON input,15.2MB largest member; process one policy path at a time.15min analysis bound below prior16min full56ledger replay;2GiB output allows compact capsule+relocation, no large policy snapshots.

reuse: Authenticated compact subsets of prior verified full runs; original identities/manifests retained, not rewritten as complete copies. No replay, model loading, fitting or API calls.
selection: Every recorded ENTER/REPLACE candidate across all six policies; bind actual intent and filled episodes separately. WAIT/HOLD/EXIT reasons preserved. Forecast ID is the exact join key; instrument/origin/target/method/model/fit/observation identities checked independently.
uncertainty: Descriptive dependent cohort; no CI,pvalue,effective sample size,causal attribution or unrun counterfactual PnL.
